The draw is consumed *before* // anything is consulted, so a card that can never upgrade still advances the rewards stream. double roll = rng.NextDouble(); if (CardRarity(cardId) == RarityRare) { // :393 excludes rare cards from the act scaling, and a combat reward passes baseChance 0 // in (:121) -- so a rare reward card never arrives upgraded. return false; } if (!RunConstants.IsUpgradableCardId(cardId)) { return false; } // :395-396: UpgradedCardOddScaling (0.125 at A10, via Scarcity -- CardFactory.cs:23-24) times // the 0-based index of the act *within this run*, added to a base chance of 0. The distinction // matters: Underdocks is an alternate Act 1 (ActModel.cs:498-507 replaces list[0] only), so a // single-act run is always index 0 and upgrades nothing, while a campaign run ramps // Act 1 0% -> Act 2 12.5% -> Act 3 25%. int actIndex = state.Campaign ? state.Act - 1 : 0; double odds = actIndex * UpgradeOddsPerActIndex; return roll <= odds;
